plainLanguage: Sections 91 hadi 93 zimefutwa; current R.E. 2022 inahifadhi repeal record tu.
meaning: No operative substantive offence remains at these section numbers in the current consolidated Code.
keyPoints: Repealed by Ordinance No. 19 of 1958 s. 15.
Historical wording should not be represented as current law.

history.summary: Section 91-93 is in Chapter X, Abuse of Office, Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official text checked against the government R.E. 2022 source.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Public-office offences should be analysed from the exact statutory duties, interests and mental elements.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Official status alone is not enough; evidence must establish the specific conduct required by the section.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence inathibitisha kila statutory element ya section 91-93?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
